scope: Requirement-based native execution pages; single evolving prerelease ZPU ABI1. Emulator qualification, not hardware conformance.

earlier_regressions.limit: These six independent regression checks predate the final CRT requirement tag. The final helper harness and complete Real matrix revalidate CRT behavior; the final four-check run is not a rerun of all ten checks.

limits: Two-page eligibility is conservative; heap, pointers, unbounded calls and unmeasured helpers retain three pages.
Standalone OS loading still transiently allocates three pages; steady program ownership is measured after startup.
Program counts exclude the IDE/compiler and auxiliary dynamic module peaks.
ZPU is unreleased ABI1 with no historical ABI compatibility contract. Rebuild experimental artifacts after compiler/runtime changes.
The full 76-command test plan, full TP recovery and hardware qualification are not claimed.
